clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

B.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
B.logical_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

A.logical_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. final_residue.scope: Separate zero tests; allocations/local/WAL may mirror the same asset.

samples.service_scope: Per resource and receiver; service does not imply equal share or general fairness bounds.

service.receiver_service_scope: Three distinct ledgers:within-window, steady+separate-tail, and all phases including warmup. No tail delivery relabeled as120s throughput.

limitations: Descriptive observations only: n1 windows and two fixed ITEM variants do not establish a population p95, significance or general capacity.
External bounds use one observer. No local_input event is assigned a variant by time, order or amount.
Trace identity comes only from post-seal actual SQL resource payloads joined by business UUID; deposit/allocation assets are not added to WAL/local mirrors.
Only same-JVM nanoTime differences are measured. Cross-server source SQL to destination reservation remains UNMEASURED; same-JVM values are confirmation observations, not exact SQL transition times.
wal_return is a successful LocalJournal.write return, including possible identical-snapshot skips. It is not an independent file/directory fsync, power-loss durability measurement, or device latency.
RX consumption hooks have no business ID. Attribution is permitted only for one allocation/apply/consume and exactly32 external variant items for that endpoint across the complete sealed window.
Main-thread quantiles are the validated deduplicated selected-root logical-cycle histograms. Method p99 is not whole-mod p99; uncovered entry points and worker costs are distinct.
Fixed counters precede final drain. Full cost includes actual drain/quiet; aggregate mixed-resource cost cannot be apportioned to an ITEM variant.
No live SQL, RCON, Minecraft, JDK/JFR parser, workload, lifecycle or fallback action is performed by this tool.
